canonical_data: SQLite-backed session, event, and credential-vault store (.managed-agents/data.db) plus local filesystem artifacts and sandbox configuration
strengths: Session, sandbox, credential, and audit/replay concerns are handled by dedicated, documented primitives — local, Docker, Kubernetes, and self-hosted worker sandboxes; a resumable Server-Sent Events stream for session replay; and a SQLite-backed credential vault — independent of which model or client drives reasoning

Speaks a Claude Managed-Agents-compatible /v1 API and a six-tool MCP bridge (list_agents, create_session, run_session, get_session, list_artifacts, stop_session), so unmodified clients such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cline, and DeepSeek Harness can drive it without a bespoke integration

Runs entirely on infrastructure the operator controls — local SQLite and filesystem storage with no required hosted control plane — and the user supplies their own OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, or OpenAI-compatible API keys
weaknesses: The runtime does not execute its own agent loop; all reasoning is delegated to an external client, so autonomy, planning quality, and task reliability are properties of whichever client connects rather than of this project

The project is about two months old with four GitHub contributors and rapid, closely spaced point releases (v0.3.4 through v0.3.8 within ten days), so operational maturity and long-term stability are unproven

The maintainer has run an unusually large, single-account self-promotion campaign — dozens of near-identical submissions to external 'awesome list' and MCP-directory repositories, most still 'maintainer review pending' — which this review independently confirmed against two of the linked pull requests; that pattern weakens confidence in community-adoption signals like stars and forks without changing the reviewed technical claims, which were verified directly against the project's own license, README, and installation documentation
why_it_matters: One of the few open, client-agnostic runtimes that treats agent session state, sandbox isolation, credentials, and audit/replay as infrastructure separate from the reasoning loop, letting operators pair it with whichever coding or chat agent they already use.
